changelog: Stores are now 100% barren upon purchase with zero automatic shelf spawning.
Store owners can repurchase all moderator-deleted props and place them anywhere inside their shop zone.
Added admin 'Clear All in Zone [X]' tool to wipe every object and entity in the store at once.
Added dedicated 'Aménagement & Mobilier' layout tab in the store owner management UI.
Overhauled customer catalog with shopping cart drawer and eliminated all native JS popups.
